content:
The execution failed due to a floating-point precision mismatch in backlog calculations and a sentence count violation in the summary report.
AssertionError: Week 6: end backlog formula mismatch occurred because abs(202.2 - 202.21000000000004) exceeded the 0.01 tolerance. The end_backlog calculation requires rounding to 2 decimal places before being used in calc_start. Additionally, catch_up_summary.txt failed validation with 'assert 4 <= 3' because the summary contained four sentences instead of the required maximum of three.
